_comment: Backlog #15 - a small, real, individually-verified overlay for items where the sim's own DB has sources:None AND the item isn't a real raid tier-set piece (those are handled generically by core/run_upgrade_sweep.py's own _TIER_TOKEN_DESC/_SET_MIN_PHASE structural rule, keyed off the item's real setId - no per-item overlay entry needed for those, see that rule's own comment for the full real evidence). STRICTLY a fallback: describe_source_and_tier() only ever consults this AFTER checking the real DB source first - an entry here can never override real DB data, only fill in a gap the DB genuinely has no source for. Every entry must be individually checked against a real source (Wowhead) before being added here - never bulk-filled from general knowledge. 'tier' is optional - omit it to keep using the existing phase-based bucket (PHASE_TO_TIER_ZONE_KEY); only set it when the item's real source venue doesn't match its own phase field.
